notes.title: Update 21/03/2021
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

In this update we add a new minigame called Lawn Ball which is a spectator game

It's a game of Blue vs Red and there are 5 lawnmowers on each team, each round counts down 30 seconds and once the score hits 0 if the ball is on the red side then the red team will gain a point but if it's on the blue side then the blue team will gain a point

The first team to hit 3 victories, is concluded the winner

Also added a prompt to the Lawnmower so you can see how to enter and leave the Lawnmower

notes.title: Update 13/03/2021 - The Collectables Full Revamp!
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

This update focuses on the collectables, let's be honest the previous collectables system was a bit rubbish

I've completely revamped the entire system, what you do now is go inside the Lawnmower and you can see what your driver sees through the windscreen

Now instead of the old collectables, you will find chests and you can open them inside your Lawnmower which unlocks LED colours, mascot decorations and lucky charms to hang from your window

You can display the collectables you've earned inside your Lawnmower and choose your favourites

As always let me know if you have any issues in the forums and if you are enjoying Grass Cutters Academy, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It promotes development and helps grow the games audience

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Update 12/03/2021 - Wrap Up Warm Update
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

So in this update it adds a chance for it to start snowing, when it snows the map will be covered in a thick blanket of snow.

The snow will also dissipate after some time and at the moment it has no impact on your lawnmwers performance

You will also notice a new tab in the menu called the Cosmetics tab, here you can purchase cursors that will replace the default one, there's 10 to collect and each cursor costs 250,000 upgrade points

More to come soon!

Thanks for the support guys

notes.title: Update 10/03/2021 - Termite Infestation
notes.notes:
Hi guys

This update adds a new vermin to the game that is more destructive than the ladybug

Termites are appearing in gardens, these vermin will target dropped items like a seeker but instead of granting you rewards it will destroy the drops so these vermin need to be dispatched quickly as they move 3 times faster than ladybirds so left unattended they can cost you dearly, 

Hunters will automatically target Termites so make sure you have some on your garden, oh and if you think they don't have champion variants, think again!

As always let me know if you have any issues in the forums and if you are enjoying Grass Cutters Academy, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It promotes development and helps grow the games audience

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Update 06/03/2021 - Idle Rewards & Chassis Upgrade
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

Hope you're well

In this update it introduces a new mechanic to reward our idle players, a lot of the latest updates have been aimed more towards the active side but i feel like as this is also an idle game we need a balance between the two

This update adds 3 new rewards which are earned by playing the game for a certain amount of time

Academy Ribbons:
These are earned for playing the game (active or minimized) for 30 minutes

Academy Medals
These are earned for playing the game (active or minimized) for 6 hours

Academy Commendations:
These are earned for playing the game (active or minimized) for 12 hours

Now i wouldn't expect you to have to play the game for 12 hours straight there's also a conversion system in the game, you can do the exchange in the stats page, it's on page 3 

You can exchange 12 Academy Ribbons for an Academy Medal, or exchange 2 Academy Medals for a commendation so if you don't want to have the game idle for such a long time at once, you can do it in short bursts 

Chassis Upgrade:

The first item to require this new currency is the new chassis upgrade which is the Magnetic Suction Module which when crafted and installed will attract all items around the player's Lawnmower to them

As always, please let me know if you have any issues in the forums

Looking forward to hearing your feedback

Thanks

~Lee

notes.title: Update 04/03/2021 - The Ejection Update
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

Hope you're doing well

This update adds functionality to eject from the lawnmower and control the driver independently

If you press Space and then click somewhere, your driver will walk to the marker, you can still purchase automowers etc, they will spawn at the vehicle

The driver comes equipped with a special gem detector and each garden will spawn a gem in a random position that can only be seen by the driver when he is within a short radius of it

You cannot find the gem whilst in the Lawnmower and the gem is worth 600 upgrade points

You can get back in the Lawnmower if you press space when standing next to it

Updates:

Made it so the player has a cursor to guide him back to the Lawnmower when out of range

notes.title: Update 02/03/2021 - Chaingun & Champion Ladybugs
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

This update adds a new craftable weapon, the Pressurised Ballistic Chaingun so you can shred those pesky ladybugs apart but unfortunately as we go into Spring, there has been sightings of larger golden ladybugs with a lot more health

It's advisable to take these out quickly as they can quickly reclaim all your gardens hard work

The chaingun works beautifully against them!

notes.title: The Crafting Update
notes.notes:
Hey Guys

This is a pretty big update, it adds a new crafting mechanic to the game

Crafting Materials:

Gardening will randomly yield new crafting materials which can be checked in the stats page or in the new warehouse page under the crafting tab

Crafting Menu:
A new crafting page has been added with background functionality for more upgrades, you will not farm materials whilst in the crafting menu

Dual Repeater Cannons:
The first item you can craft is a new weapon for your lawnmower, the dual repeater cannons require a set amount of materials to craft and they deal twice the damage to vermin than the standard turret


Coming Soon:


Chassis upgrades

notes.title: Update 26/02/2021 - Turf War Gamemode
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

This update adds a little minigame you can play called Turf War

Turf War is a head to head gamemode where you go up against 3 auto mowers and the goal is to paint more of the garden red than the other mowers paint blue, pink or orange in 60 seconds

Manual cutting is still counted in Turf War and it can be accessed via the top of the menu

notes.title: Update 25/02/2021
notes.notes:
Quite a big update this one guys

So i've completely changed the way the save system works in the game, now your game wont be wiped with each update so i've been able to add a few new features to the game 

Pets:

You can now unlock pet snails in the game that will follow you around whilst granting you unique bonuses including speed boosts and unique flairs

There are currently 5 pets to collect and they are unlocked by cutting grass (obviously!)


Academy:

The academy is Grass Cutters prestige system, there are 10 ranks in the academy and each rank allows you to progress your speed stats by +10

In order to rank up it costs a certain amount of upgrade points and maxed out speed upgrades, once you select rank up and confirm it, it will clear your speed upgrades back to 0 but you will be able to upgrade by 10 more speed each rank up to a total of 199 so enjoy zipping around those gardens!


Fixes:

Ladybugs spawn rate slightly increased
No small gardens or medium gardens, just large gardens
Various optimizations

notes.title: Update 16/02/2021 - Vermin, Cannons & Automation
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

Sorry but this update requires a new game start but it does include an important update

Updates:

Automation:
You can now set an amount of Auto Mowers to automatically purchase when you start a new game so you can now play the game completely idle

Vermin:
Ladybugs have been seen randomly appearing in gardens, these Vermin cause grass that they touch to grow back quickly thus slowing your garden cutting achievements, you will need a special kind of tool to deal with these

Cannons:
Your Lawnmower has been fitted with an auto cannon which will automatically target nearby Ladybugs

Automated Hunter Mowers:
You can now purchase Hunters which will race around your garden and automatically shoot Ladybugs around them

Fixes:

Various Background Optimizations
